descriptive_title: Grade 1 Language: Demonstrations — Decoding CVC Words (B2.1-B2.3)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 1 phonics unit on decoding CVC words framed around Sounder Sam the Owl and Blendy the Bear. Children move from auditory phoneme awareness through letter-sound mapping to blending and decoding connected text.
long_description: Sounder Sam and Blendy lead a 5-day Science of Reading-aligned phonics journey! This Ontario 2023-aligned Grade 1 Language unit covers all 3 B2 expectations (B2.1-B2.3). Day 1 isolates and segments phonemes (auditory only). Day 2 maps letters to sounds. Day 3 blends three sounds into CVC words. Day 4 decodes CVC words in short sentences. Day 5 closes with a Big Decoder Capstone — 4 stations integrating HEAR, MAP, BLEND, READ. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-1 trap: letter-name interference, name-leakage, choppy-blend, freeze-at-unknown, integration), 5 student worksheets, 9 paper manipulatives (all everyday classroom items), formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 3-row summative rubric, and Junior Decoder G1 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 1 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day phonics unit aligned with the 2023 Science of Reading update (B2.1-B2.3).
subject: Language
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on Science of Reading-aligned phonics with character-driven Sounder + Blendy frame, structured pair work, and progression from phonological awareness to letter-sound mapping to blending to connected text decoding.
